title: Canonical separating coordinates in the generalized cubic Hénon-Heiles systems
summary: We study the three classical integrable generalized cubic Hénon--Heiles systems -- Kaup--Kupershmidt, KdV$_5$, and Sawada--Kotera -- from the viewpoint of bi-Hamiltonian geometry and separation of variables. On the standard symplectic manifold $T^*\mathbb R^2$, we construct compatible Poisson deformations $P_1=L_XP_0$, compute the associated recursion operators $N=P_1P_0^{-1}$, and analyze the action of $N^*$ on the codistribution generated by the first integrals.
